captions.detailed: A bridge-camera style lens module consisting of a dark grey and black cylindrical body. It features a wide front barrel, an integrated camera-lens scale on top, a ribbed zoom ring, and a light grey manual-focus clutch ring. An inner cylindrical tube with a blue-tinted glass lens element extends forward from the main assembly. The zoom ring and the clutch ring rotate independently along the main optical axis, while the inner lens tube translates linearly along the same axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a bridge-camera style lens module with a ribbed zoom ring, a light grey manual-focus clutch ring, and an extending inner tube holding a blue lens. Incorporate continuous rotational joints for the rings and a prismatic sliding joint for the inner lens barrel along the optical axis.
captions.factory: Construct the main lens body using a combination of coaxial cylinders, adding a small box with a white/black face for the lens scale. Model the zoom ring and clutch ring as separate cylindrical bands, adding a ribbed texture to the zoom ring using patterned cuts or rings. Create the inner sliding barrel as a smaller cylinder capped with a blue circular face representing the glass lens. Define continuous joints for the zoom ring and clutch ring, and a prismatic joint for the inner barrel along the Z-axis.
